pages.title: What the Relay Was Doing
pages.text: Changing flow is normal, not a fault. A relay balances connected stores by charge percentage, so it has no single fixed OP/t rating; flow naturally changes with charge and free space at both ends.

pages.title: Draconic Relay
pages.text: The Draconic Relay is a Fusion upgrade. The surviving notes do not preserve its complete material arrangement.
